name: Short-Stay Visa (Visa C) / Visa-Free Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Kosovo Border Police brochure: the Government of Kosovo sets the visa regime by decision, so visa-exempt status varies by nationality (a full country list was not confirmed against a single source in this build). Visa-exempt visitors and Visa C (short-stay) holders may stay up to 90 days within any 180-day period. Kosovo issues Schengen-style visa categories: air-transit (A, multiple entry up to 6 months), transit (B, variable duration, multiple entry up to 6 months), short-stay (C, up to 90 days per 180-day period, with the visa itself valid 6 months to 5 years), and a single-entry residence visa (D, valid 3 months) issued once a residence permit is confirmed for those moving to a longer-stay category.
requirements.fix_path: Non-exempt nationalities apply for a Visa C at a Kosovo diplomatic mission before travel; those transitioning to residence use a Visa D once their residence permit is confirmed.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period (Visa C / visa-exempt)

sources.title: Kosovo Police (official government body) -- Guidelines for Entry, Movement, Residence and Employment of Foreigners: visa categories A-D, 90/180 short-stay rule

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kosovo). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to Kosovo Police's own official brochure, tier 1. Modeled as country code XK, the de facto ISO-adjacent code used by the EU, SWIFT, and most international systems in the absence of an official ISO 3166-1 assignment (a consequence of Kosovo's contested statehood, not a data-quality gap). Kosovo's own residence-category system is notably more developed and EU-accession-aligned than most other countries built recently in this dataset (Mali, Niger, Haiti, Bosnia) -- a genuine, positive structural contrast worth noting: Kosovo runs a real Schengen-style visa-category system (A/B/C/D) and, per xk_citizenship_naturalisation.json and related files, an actual temporary-to-permanent residence LADDER, which several of those other countries lack entirely. A complete visa-exempt nationality list was not confirmed against a single authoritative source in this build -- genuine, disclosed gap. switchable_to reflects that Visa D is the actual mechanism for converting to residence-based status.
